theorems.name: Submission.aestronglyMeasurable_normalRadialSq_and_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (ξ : Ambient n ℓ), AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x ↦ (V.tangentSpace x).starProjection) V.weight → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x ↦ V.normalRadialSq ξ x) V.weight ∧ ∀ x, 0 ≤ V.normalRadialSq ξ x ∧ V.normalRadialSq ξ x ≤ 1
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
